title: Record the source value of the first restored half
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 23507, register 343 holds `-8` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `8` and contributes `-64` to register 103, which is `0` until then.
- Event 23274 adds register 18 at `-4`. Event 23304 adds `2` times register 39 at `-2`. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
